title: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure / Raktachapa) — Dual-System Monograph
content:
Condition: Essential Hypertension (Blood Pressure >= 140/90 mmHg).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Amlodipine 5mg (Calcium channel blocker), Telmisartan 40mg (Angiotensin Receptor Blocker), or Enalapril (ACE inhibitor). Once-daily dosing with regular BP charting.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Sarpagandha Vati (250mg under clinical guidance - natural Rauwolfia containing reserpine). Arjuna Ksheerapaka (Terminalia arjuna bark boiled in milk/water 3-5g daily for cardio-protection and arterial tone). Mukta Vati.
Home Remedies & Diet: Raw Garlic (Lashuna 1-2 crushed cloves morning), Hibiscus tea, DASH diet (low sodium < 2g/day, high potassium), Anulom-Vilom pranayama (15 minutes daily).
Emergency: BP > 180/120 mmHg with chest pain, shortness of breath, or headache is a hypertensive emergency (Dial 112).
